  • Method Details

    • login

      public static Auth.Employee login(String user, String password) throws SQLException
      Signs in an employee. The user can type either the username or the numeric employee ID.
      Parameters:
      user - the username or the employee ID
      password - the plain-text password
      Returns:
      the matching active employee, or null if the username/ID or password is wrong
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the database query fails

    • firstActive

      public static Auth.Employee firstActive(String role) throws SQLException
      Finds the active employee with the lowest ID in a role.
      Parameters:
      role - the role to search, CASHIER or MANAGER
      Returns:
      the first active employee in the role, or null if there is none
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the database query fails

    • sha256

      public static String sha256(String input)
      Hashes a password the same way as the password_hash column in the employee table.
      Parameters:
      input - the text to hash
      Returns:
      the hex SHA-256 of the input
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the JVM has no SHA-256 implementation
